item.title: anthropic 2.10.0
item.description: breaking / deprecated wording Breaking keyword in a minor release Quote: * **types:** keep deprecated model aliases and the types nested under them working Quote: * **api:** rename error data models, deprecating the old names Quote: * **internal:** don't report moved classes as breaking changes Release notes: https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/releases/tag/v2.10.0

item.title: anthropic 2.9.0
item.description: breaking / deprecated wording Breaking keyword in a minor release Quote: The tool no longer runs an `rg` from a relative or empty `PATH` entry or, on Windows, from the current directory. On Windows it looks for `rg.exe`, so an `rg.cmd`, `rg.bat` or `rg.com` is no longer used. With no other `rg` on `PATH`, the tool uses its built-in search. Quote: `rg` no longer gets the `ANTHROPIC_*` variables of the process, like the shell of `bash`. Quote: For a terminated session, the worker now force-stops the work item right after it retrieves the session, before it downloads skills or memory stores. It no longer raises `SessionMemoryError` for such a session. The API reports an archived session as `terminated`. Release notes: https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/releases/tag/v2.9.0
